Name: Custom Producer Mod
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Objective:[/b][/size]
This content pack should work as base for player to change their vanilla machines.

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Unzip the Producer Framework Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4992]Unzip the Custom Producer Mod[/url] into /Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Machines Implemented:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Keg
[*]Preserve Jar (Roe is now supported)
[*]﻿Cheese Press
[*]﻿Mayonnaise Machine
[*]﻿Loom
[*]Oil Maker
[*]Seed Maker (Only one seed as an example)
[*]﻿Recycling Machine
[*]﻿Furnace
[*]﻿Charcoal Kiln
[*]﻿Slime Egg-Press
[*]Mushroom Box
[*]Worm Bin
[*]Statue Of Perfection
[*]Soda Machine
[*]Bee House
[/list]
[size=3][b]Differences:[/b][/size][list]
[*]Messages about stack and required items are slightly different in some cases. Ex. It will say "Require 5 Coffee Beans" instead of "Require 5 beans"
[*]Required messages aren't all internationalized in Producer Framework Mod. If you want to help, sent them to PFM page.
[/list]
